task: Verify real googleapis/gaxios error shape for booking classifier
summary: Verified isConfirmedGoogleFailure against REAL network calls through the actual googleapis/gaxios libraries (no mocking): a fake-but-real JWT auth attempt against Google's live OAuth token endpoint returned a genuine GaxiosError with both .status and .response.status set to 400 (invalid_grant), classified correctly as a confirmed failure. A real DNS failure (gaxios request to a non-resolving host) returned a GaxiosError with no .response/.status and a string .code ('ENOTFOUND'), classified correctly as ambiguous. No code discrepancy was found, so no source changes were made.
